- **Read narrowly.** Prefer targeted search + ranged reads over whole-file dumps; never re-read a file you just edited.

- **Keep the diff surgical** — small diffs mean small reviewer/review inputs.
- **Checkpoint to disk continuously:** commit, open/update the PR, and record progress in the issue so state never lives
